Nagsagawa kamakailan ng tatlong araw na K-9 Search and Rescue Simulation Exercise ang Metropolitan Manila Development Authority, sa pangunguna ng MMDA K-9 Unit, sa MMDA Nature Park sa Carmona, Cavite.

Kasama sa aktibidad ang K-9 teams mula Pasig CDRRMO K9, gayundin ang mga volunteer-based Search and Rescue Groups gaya ng UPMV K9, Muntinlupa K9 Search and Rescue - SAR, at Philippine Canine Emergency Response Team, Inc. (PCERT).

Sinukat ng simulation exercise ang operational readiness at lakas ng inter-agency collaboration sa pagitan ng mga grupo, at pagsusulong ng international standards sa K-9 search and rescue training.

Nagkasa ng realistic search area scenarios gaya ng collapsed structures, rubble fields, at confined spaces para makita kung paano ang galaw ng handler at K-9 partners sa gitna ng high-stress at time-critical conditions gaya ng lindol o landslide.

Nagkaroon din ng serye ng komprehensibong mga drill para subukin ang agility, obedience, at stability ng mga aso alinsunod sa International Search and Rescue Dog Organization. #mmda #mmdak9unit

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 7 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Tropical Storm CRISING
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 18 July 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Bataan, Zambales, Quezon, Rizal, Laguna, Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas and Bulacan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Tarlac and Pampanga which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
